displayName: Xiaomi Bluetooth Voice Remote 2 Pro / RC003

support.notes: Migrated Windows Rust implementation is real-device verified for RC003 voice and ordinary buttons. macOS upstream is implemented. This profile records device facts, not current runtime connection state.

bluetoothNames: 小米蓝牙语音遥控器 2 Pro

transports.notes: ATVV capability negotiation, voice control and 16 kHz IMA/DVI ADPCM stream.
Raw Input/HID on Windows; IOHID on macOS. Voice key is handled by the voice path, not the mapping engine.

protocols.notes: ATVV service with control/audio characteristics and balanced session start/stop.

platforms.notes: Implemented and real-device accepted in the upstream macOS products. Not this Windows repository.
Migrated Windows Rust implementation. Return/volume enhanced capture is optional and depends on the native helper.
No Linux adapter has been implemented.
